results.title: Artemis: To the Moon and Back
results.original_title: Artemis: To the Moon and Back
results.overview: The inside story of the Artemis II mission - filmed over three and a half years at NASA. How did four astronauts travel to the moon, going deeper into space than ever before?

results.title: Mother's Pride
results.overview: A comedy about a failing pub, a divided community and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

results.title: The Great Warsaw Race
results.overview: A young jockey Krzysiek dreams of competing in a prestigious race - the Great Warsaw Race. He enters the world of horse racing with the naivety of an enthusiastic newcomer. He quickly realizes though that the racetrack is a web of dependencies, powerful interests, and manipulated results. Krzysiek hopes he can change it. But in a world of corruption and dirty deals it's hard to remain unblemished.

results.title: Masquerade
results.overview: Glenville is riddled with crime, and one man takes it upon himself to change this. Follow Masquerade as he experiences the town's many personalities; some need saving more than others...

results.title: Samurai Ballerina -L'étoile de Paris en fleur-
results.original_title: パリに咲くエトワール
results.overview: Paris in the early 20th century. Fujiko dreams of becoming a painter despite expectations of marriage, while Chizuru, born into a samurai family, longs to study ballet. Reunited in Paris after meeting as children, they support each other and move toward their dreams.

results.title: Gandhi Talks
results.overview: A young, unemployed graduate Mahadev's struggles to land a job through any means possible and crosses paths with a businessman and petty thief.

results.title: La nuit
results.overview: Blanche has been promoted to a job in another city. She and Damien and their kids thus change places, to this place on the oceanside ; Blanche felt like changing something. But something is different. Damien dreams of a car accident, of a roadcurve above the ocean... Of a woman’s face. Then he meets this woman, whilst running on a road above the ocean, precisely… She is Ariane. Damien’s arrival has made her reappear. She is dead. : she died in the car accident Damien dreamt of. She is here, in flesh and blood. He sinks into an irrepressible passion with her, in her arms. Blanche has no idea what’s happening of course, but she sees Damien slowly drifting…  Around them, the world is as good as empty. There is nothing left but matter.

results.title: Captain Newfoundland
results.overview: Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.

results.title: The Bulldogs
results.overview: Following a catastrophic train derailment, The Bulldogs follows the residents of a small rural community in East Palestine, Ohio, as they navigate an uncertain path to recovery.

results.title: Eine Nacht in Bangkok
results.overview: Katharina and Hektor who used to be married ten years ago meet again after their daughter Lilith is suspected of serial burglary.

results.title: Bouchra
results.overview: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

results.title: Lily Brett - Laughter Can Pierce Pain
results.original_title: Lily Brett - Lachen gegen das Grauen
results.overview: In 1948, a little girl sits smiling on a Parisian carousel – for the first time she experiences a moment of carefree childhood. Her parents are Holocaust survivors; Lily Brett was born just after the end of World War II in a DP camp in Feldafing. The writer Lily Brett artistically explores the trauma she inherited in a remarkable way, marked by gentle humor rather than bitterness or anger. Not as an accuser, but as a bridgebuilder.

results.title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn
results.overview: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a story that followed Stewart for decades.

results.title: Sister Sister 3
results.overview: Set in traditional Northern Vietnam, where strict social norms prevail, Thi Mau - the region's most beautiful and talented young lady - finds herself caught in a tangled web of secret love and conflicting desires.

results.title: Postcards for Christmas
results.overview: Hannah Norton moves to Mistletoe Valley for the holidays to work at the post office alongside her best friend from college. She discovers that the post office is full of undeliverable mail, including several love letters from the same man. Hannah sets out to solve the mystery - with the help of Ford Montgomery, a DJ at a local radio station.

results.title: Your Lips Never Left Mine
results.overview: A young woman is hired by a finance couple to tutor their son at their summer lake house, and finds herself increasingly enmeshed in the undisclosed darkness of their past.

results.title: Bloody Tennis
results.overview: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.
